title: noema-lite pack translation (noema-translation v1)
description: One translation of a pack in its own file (<id>.tr.<locale>.json, translations/<locale>.json in the package, noema_save_translation): the chapters in one language with the pack's ids, structure and answers, and the subject's name in it. docs/i18n.md §10. That the chapters match the pack's is checked by engine/packcheck.js checkTranslation.

pack.x-message: the subject id the translation belongs to (pack.subject.id)

locale.x-message: the language of the translation (e.g. el, ru, pt-PT)

subject.x-message: an object {title, appTitle, description, searchExamples, hero, tutor} in the translation's language

chapters.x-message: must be a non-empty list of translated chapters
